clips.title: The story
paras: Warriors gather on Fray Island, just off the Merchant Coast of the Barrens. The rocky islet holds a rough training ring where fighters from across Azeroth test their skill.

Fray Island lies off the eastern bluffs of the Barrens, beyond the watchful eyes of Orgrimmar and Theramore. Warriors of every race and creed train here. At the island's heart, Klannoc Macleod oversees a fighting arena where seasoned fighters and raw recruits meet in brutal brawls.

The ring on Fray Island follows a simple code of martial combat, despite the hostile waters around it. Warriors come at their trainers' direction to face The Affray, a grueling gauntlet against waves of challengers that ends with a bout against champion Big Will. Here, Horde and Alliance allegiance gives way to strength and martial discipline.
